title: CLTR Cutover NotificationAuthorityBinding record
description: Phase 136T, Implementation Group 10 (CLTR-CUTOVER-EXECUTABLE-SCHEMAS-001 v1.0 Sec.31, Sec.46). A NotificationAuthorityBinding document describes a claimed PFN-001 notification-dispatch association for a specific authoritative generation; it never itself dispatches a notification, proves external delivery, proves exactly-once behavior, creates a marker, creates a receipt, mutates lifecycle state, publishes authority, or triggers execution (Sec.1, Sec.31, Sec.40). Legacy lifecycle remains the sole production authority; CLTR remains derivative. Tier 2 (_extensions only, Sec.14). authority_role 'authoritative' is locally forbidden (Sec.9's 12-file list includes all three binding schemas). Not in the phase_id-required or transition_id-required family lists (Sec.7.2), so neither field is declared here. Sec.31's field table omits the universal envelope fields (schema_id, schema_version, contract_version, record_type, record_id, created_at, migration_epoch) and authority_disclosure, and names the record's own digest field 'digest' rather than 'record_digest'; consistent with every other of the 11 already-implemented families and with the field-naming precedent established by those families, this schema applies the uniform envelope + authority_disclosure struct and treats the table's 'digest' entry as the standard record_digest envelope field, not a second distinct field -- disclosed as NON-BLOCKING-136T-1 (a discrepancy resolution, not an invented field). authoritative_generation_reference is typed using the dedicated shared/references.schema.json#/$defs/generation_reference shape (id+digest only) rather than the field table's literal 'record_reference' typing, since 'generation' is not itself a record_family enum value and so cannot be family-restricted the way a record_reference is -- this mirrors the precedent already established and disclosed at NON-BLOCKING-136N-2 for cas_expectation's expected_authoritative_generation field.

schema_id.description: Always present. Identifies this document as validated against the NotificationAuthorityBinding schema.

schema_version.description: Always present. This file's own MAJOR.MINOR version.

contract_version.description: Always present. CLTR-CUTOVER-EXECUTABLE-SCHEMAS-001 version this schema was generated against.

record_type.description: Always present. Fixed family tag for this record type.

record_id.description: Always present. Shape-checked only; never recomputed at Layer 2.

record_digest.description: Always present. Digest of this document itself. Shape-checked only; never recomputed at Layer 2. Restates Sec.31's 'digest' field (NON-BLOCKING-136T-1).

created_at.description: Always present. Never used to establish record identity or ordering across documents.

migration_epoch.description: Always present. Every companion record binds to exactly one migration epoch (Sec.7.2, CSCH-INV-1). notification_authority_binding is not in the phase_id-required or transition_id-required family lists (Sec.7.2).

authoritative_generation_reference.description: Always present (Sec.31). See NON-BLOCKING-136T-1/NON-BLOCKING-136N-2 disclosure above for the generation_reference-versus-record_reference typing choice. A schema-valid reference never itself proves that generation is currently authoritative (Layer 4/6).

authority_epoch_reference.description: Always present (Sec.31). Family-tagged reference to the governing AuthorityEpoch. A valid reference never implies the referenced epoch exists or is currently active (Layer 4/6).

payload_digest.description: Always present (Sec.31). Shape-checked only; never recomputed against actual notification payload bytes at Layer 2 (Layer 3).

attempt_identity.description: Always present (Sec.31). Opaque dispatch-attempt identity string, Sec.10 generic identifier shape. Not itself a companion record_id and not a record_reference -- a bare identity token binding this document to one dispatch attempt. Never recomputed or verified for determinism at Layer 2 (Layer 4).

pfn001_classification.description: Always present (Sec.31). Restates the existing PFN-001 classification vocabulary; not redefined by this schema (Sec.31 explicit instruction). Shape-checked as a bounded printable-ASCII string only -- this schema does not enumerate or validate against PFN-001's actual closed vocabulary.

delivery_state.description: Always present (Sec.31). Record-local DeliveryState (Sec.8.8, 3 values), home schema this file per Sec.8.8's specific per-family table. 'payload_conflict' requires uncertainty; any value other than 'not_dispatched' requires marker_reference; 'already_dispatched' requires receipt_reference (all enforced below). A schema-valid delivery_state value never itself proves external delivery occurred (Layer 4/40).

uncertainty.description: Conditionally present: required when delivery_state is 'payload_conflict', forbidden otherwise (Sec.31).

marker_reference.description: Conditionally present: required when delivery_state is not 'not_dispatched' (i.e. 'already_dispatched' or 'payload_conflict'), forbidden when delivery_state is 'not_dispatched' (Sec.31). Family-tagged reference restricted to marker_authority_binding; a valid reference never implies the referenced marker exists or matches (Layer 4).

receipt_reference.description: Conditionally present: required when delivery_state is 'already_dispatched', forbidden otherwise (Sec.31). Family-tagged reference restricted to receipt_authority_binding; a valid reference never implies the referenced receipt exists, matches, or is finalized (Layer 4).

authority_disclosure.description: Always present. authority_role 'authoritative' is locally forbidden on this record (Sec.9's 12-file list); is_authoritative remains const false per the shared definition regardless. A valid NotificationAuthorityBinding record never itself proves a notification was dispatched, delivered exactly once, or that its claimed marker/receipt bindings are correct.

_extensions.description: Conditionally present: the single reserved Tier 2 extension key (Sec.14). String-valued map only, no nested arbitrary structure. Forward-compatible annotation only; never authority-bearing, never interpreted as notification dispatch.

pfn001_classification.description: Bounded single-line printable-ASCII-only string. Restates the existing PFN-001 classification vocabulary as shape only (Sec.31); no closed enum is imposed here.

reason.description: Always present when this object is present. Short, fixed-purpose uncertainty disclosure sentence.

uncertainty.description: Bounded local uncertainty-disclosure object (mirrors publication_attempt.schema.json's uncertainty $def). Present only when delivery_state is 'payload_conflict'.

epoch_reference.description: A record_reference locally restricted to record_family 'authority_epoch' (mirrors publication_attempt.schema.json's epoch_reference precedent -- no schema_id/schema_version required).

marker_reference.description: A record_reference locally restricted to record_family 'marker_authority_binding', with schema_id/schema_version unconditionally required (Sec.12 cross-family rule).

receipt_reference.description: A record_reference locally restricted to record_family 'receipt_authority_binding', with schema_id/schema_version unconditionally required (Sec.12 cross-family rule).
